purpose: Authored programs; no production certification implied

cards.review_basis: Catalog wording mapped to shared type unions, destruction or mandatory complete-set movement. Normal costs and printed characteristics retained. General regeneration, replacement/layer and production gates remain separate.

Printed types and normal cost. Separate free colorless and colored-with-damage mana abilities use shared immediate effect classification, a single paid color choice, and the common damage pipeline. Damage is not a life payment; source lifelink and state-based loss timing remain shared. General production gates remain separate.

Catalog face mapped to the shared life-gain event and counter instruction. CR 119.9 treats separate lifelink sources as separate gains and zero life as no gain. General color/layer and runtime gates remain separate.

Cycling uses hand activation, exact source discard cost, ordinary stack resolution and draw (pinned CR 702.29a-b). Printed spell destruction uses the shared complete-set type union; land entry and intrinsic basic-land mana use shared rules. Cycling-specific trigger and cost-modifier interactions remain part of the general production gates.

Printed 3RR enchantment uses shared counter-placement actor attribution, per-recipient aggregated event amounts and opponent player/creature/planeswalker targeting. Entry counters, replacements, proliferate, copies and resolution rechecks use existing primitives. Production gates remain separate.

Printed 3WW 2/1 flying/vigilance/lifelink Angel Artificer and controlled-other-creature anthem. Fabricate composes optional +1/+1 counters with an exact-source availability check and a fallback creating two colorless 1/1 artifact creature Servos in one batch. Shared primitives only; production gates remain separate.

Printed 2W flying 2/2 Angel combines additive controller life-gain replacement with self +2/+2 at 25 life. Shared replacement calculation applies to ordinary gains and atomic lifelink damage, once per source gain event. Copy/control/phasing and zero gains use shared primitives. Production gates remain separate.

Printed Aura cost and continuous bonuses; shared attached-object death observation and exact graveyard Aura tracking under CR 400.7f and 603.6e. No named runtime branch; production gates remain separate.

Printed characteristics and costs mapped to shared immediate mana choices. Commander identities bind at game creation, use the current controller, and distinguish unknown identities from colorless identities. General production readiness remains separately gated.

Printed characteristics and costs mapped to one atomic activation zone-cost group, ordinary stack resolution, shared search/scry/draw, subtype-union selectors and tapped-entry instructions where printed. Omen uses the generic flash casting permission. Replacement choices precede payment and accepted costs are never replayed. General production gates remain separate.

Full printed face authored using existing shared cost, targeting, copy/entry, ETB/landfall, movement, search, continuous-characteristic and mana operations as applicable. The card program supplies data only; no runtime card-name branch. Whole-pod production admission and unfinished generic rules remain separate.

Printed characteristics compose embedded token programs and atomic token entry with existing ETB/landfall patterns, numeric land counts, optional complete-set counters, search/threshold sequencing, and resource/zone activation costs. Token definitions retain name, subtypes, colors and power/toughness; no card-name runtime handlers. Whole-pod and production adapter gates remain incomplete.

Printed costs, characteristics and text compose shared player permissions and ordinary mana/draw operations. Current static sources and temporary grants combine; land plays compare the current total allowance against all lands already played. Graveyard permission preserves ownership and timing; unlimited hand size is evaluated before cleanup expiration. Production admission remains separate.

Printed characteristics and abilities use shared battlefield-count quantities, mana production, normal costs and entry replacements. Counts use effective subtypes at resolution after payment; opponent and source inclusion follows the printed selector. Production admission remains separate.

Catalog face and normal casting cost manually mapped to shared targeting, zone movement, ETB draw and printed combat keyword primitives. Runtime loss, permissions, layers and production admission remain separately gated.

Printed clauses compose shared fixed-recipient temporary continuous effects and layer-six keyword grants with existing targeting, counters, event triggers, source statistics and mana/zone costs. Numeric values bind at resolution; exact incarnations and cleanup expiration govern lifetime. Production gates remain separate.

Printed characteristics compose target-domain validation, lexical former-controller capture, ordinary destruction/countering and atomic recipient-owned token creation. Creation is not conditional on successful removal; normal all-targets-illegal resolution still suppresses the spell. General regeneration, uncounterability, replacement and production gates remain separate.
